items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was a saxophonist—Bobby Jaspar, and he played… he wound up playing.

ctx.x: There was just… We weren’t that [unintelligible] as a group. [laughs] But there were good musicians. There was a saxophonist—Bobby Jaspar, and he played… he wound up playing. He came here and played a lot.
